plan.archetype: Poison scaling, early area damage, and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Bring area damage, reliable poison, upgraded defensive scaling, and potions. Remove followers promptly while controlling incoming damage; enter near full health.
plan.summary: Visit five question rooms when safely reachable to activate Seek. Acquire early damage before expensive scaling, then improve poison and defense. Fight elites only after meaningful upgrades; remove Strikes and avoid speculative cards.

plan.archetype: Area damage and poison scaling behind dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Bring upgraded Footwork, stronger area damage, dependable scaling, and potions. Kill followers promptly; heal before the boss when needed.
plan.summary: Keep the safe three-question route to activate Seek. Improve area damage and sustained defense rather than forcing poison synergies. Skip optional elites; use later camps to balance healing and upgrades.

plan.archetype: Opening acceleration into passive damage scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Acquire dependable damage scaling and multihit mitigation. Upgrade Nightmare; copy Footwork+ when affordable. Preserve potions and enough HP for prolonged combat.
plan.summary: Use permanent opening energy to establish scaling quickly. Shop for passive damage and mitigation, remove Strikes, and use four camps to balance essential upgrades with healing. Avoid elites until the deck improves.

plan.archetype: Repeatable vulnerability and passive damage behind dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Establish recurring damage, Footwork and Fasten. Maintain Weak against multihits; use Nightmare on affordable scaling or Footwork. Preserve enough HP for prolonged combat.
plan.summary: Keep the camp-heavy route. Strengthen sustained offense rather than adding modest attacks or speculative poison multipliers. Remove Strikes, upgrade reusable support, and heal before dangerous stretches.
